operations.title: RH is equivalent to a theta-defined Stieltjes moment representation
operations.statement: For B(y)=Xi(iy) and R_Xi(x)=d/dx log B(sqrt x), RH holds iff R_Xi is a Stieltjes function. Under RH its positive measure is sum m_gamma delta_(gamma^2); conversely Stieltjes analyticity forces all logarithmic-derivative poles to the negative real squared axis and hence all Xi zeros real. Complete-monotonicity derivatives and Hankel moment minors give source-only finite falsifiers.
operations.scope: Unconditional equivalence and falsifier hierarchy; no proof of the Stieltjes property or Mellin boundary identification.
